title: Star Catch
tagline: Catch the stars before time runs out.
shortDescription: Fly a little firefly across the night sky and catch as many stars as you can in 60 seconds. A tiny starter game for building your own.
longDescription: Star Catch is the Ai Kids Games starter template: a tiny but complete game that follows the game contract. A firefly flies toward wherever you steer it with the keyboard, a gamepad, the mouse or a finger, catching stars for 60 seconds. Replace its rules, art and name with your own game, and keep the plumbing: the single-file build, safe storage, the test hook, the capture route and the tests.
features: Plays with keyboard, mouse, touch or gamepad
Remembers your best score on this device
One self-contained HTML file that works offline
contentNotes: Gentle arcade play with no fighting or scary content. The best score saves in this browser.

quickStart: Fly with the arrow keys, a gamepad stick, or hold your finger where you want to go.
Catch as many stars as you can before the time runs out.
howToPlay: Fly with WASD or the arrow keys, a gamepad's left stick or d-pad, or hold the mouse or a finger where you want to go.
Escape or P pauses; gamepad A or Start presses the buttons in menus.
